description:
The tunnel you can inspect.

BULBVPN is a lean, free VPN — one tap on the orb and the evidence appears on screen: your public exit IP, the server you landed on, and a plain-text session log written line by line.

HOW IT WORKS
• Connect — Tap the bulb. The app pulls the live community endpoint list (VPN Gate, ~96 nodes, refreshed on every attempt), picks the lowest-ping host with a valid OpenVPN profile, and negotiates the tunnel with each stage reported live.
• Verify — The moment the tunnel is up, your exit IP and country appear on the home screen with a copy button. Paste it into any lookup service and check the claim yourself.
• Prove it — Run the built-in throughput check against Cloudflare's edge: latency, jitter, packet loss, download and upload — measured through the tunnel, not estimated.
• Read the tape — Every handshake, retry and state change is appended to an on-device log. When something behaves oddly, the evidence is already there. Logs are live, auto-scroll, and clearable.

WHAT IT IS — AND ISN'T
• OpenVPN core. Community VPN Gate endpoints (operators are independent — they can see your incoming IP and destinations).
• No account, no subscription wall, no browsing history uploaded. Free forever, solo enterprise.
• Sends only: connection events to Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, an exit-IP lookup to Cloudflare trace, the endpoint list from a public GitHub mirror, and Google's connectivity probe. See Privacy Policy for the full list.
• No Kill Switch claim, no no-log marketing — the log IS the product.

BUILT TO BE CHECKED
Servers are sorted by ping (lowest first), Auto Select picks the fastest valid node and shows country/IP/ping/speed. The connected orb becomes a throughput gauge (needle driven by bytes/sec). Designed under the Filament system — Night Canvas #0A0D14, single Filament Amber accent, Geist Mono for numbers, Outfit for UI.
